design.summary: Lean, quick shadow-thief in dark grey leathers with a long crimson scarf and two crossed daggers.
design.silhouette: Wide low hood with a pointed tip, scarf tail streaming to one side, two short blades jutting out at the hips; short and wide.

headgear.description: Deep dark-grey pointed hood that shades the eyes, hood tip flopping to the back, a small crimson trim line at the brim.

armour.description: Dark-grey leather jerkin with two crossing belts.
Wide belt with a steel buckle and two dagger sheaths.
Soft grey boots with folded cuffs.

design.cloth: Long crimson scarf wrapped twice around the neck with two tails trailing behind; short dark-grey half cape at the back.
design.weapon_summary: Two short curved steel daggers with dark-grey grips, one in each hand, blades pointing forward and down when idle.

proportions.style: short wide chibi: big head (about 1/3 of the height), stocky wide torso, short thick limbs, big hands and boots
proportions.notes: Standing height is equal in the down, up and right views. Feet of every frame rest on ONE baseline row.

weapon.name: twin daggers
weapon.description: Two short curved steel daggers with dark-grey grips, one in each hand, blades pointing forward and down when idle.

down.descriptor: FRONT view (down): the figure faces the camera, face and chest visible, both boots visible, toes toward the viewer.

up.descriptor: BACK view (up): the figure faces away from the camera. NO face, NO eyes, NO mouth anywhere: show only the back of the head/headgear, the back of the torso, back armour and the cape/cloth hanging down the back, and the heels of both boots. Back view: hood tip, scarf tails hanging down the back, crossed belts, two dagger hilts at the lower back.

right.descriptor: RIGHT side view (right): a TRUE side profile facing the right edge of the image, body turned exactly 90 degrees, one eye only, nose/brow in profile; the NEAR arm and NEAR leg are drawn IN FRONT of the torso, the far limbs partly hidden behind it.

poses: Stand relaxed, feet shoulder-width apart, twin daggers held low in both hands, chest rests low.
Breathe in: torso rises one pixel step, shoulders lift slightly, the crimson scarf tails.
Peak of the breath: head and chest at their highest, arms swing a hair outward, the crimson scarf tails sways a little.
Breathe out: torso sinks back lower than frame 1, weight shifts slightly, the crimson scarf tails settles.
Contact: left boot planted forward, right boot behind on its toes, arms opposite to legs, twin daggers held low in both hands.
Down: body at its lowest, left boot flat under the body, right boot lifting off, right knee bent.
Passing: right leg swings through beside the planted left leg, body at its highest, the crimson scarf tails.
Contact: right boot planted forward, left boot behind on its toes, arms swapped, twin daggers held low in both hands.
Down: body at its lowest, right boot flat under the body, left boot lifting off, left knee bent.
Passing: left leg swings through beside the planted right leg, body at its highest, the crimson scarf tails flares.
Wind-up: both daggers pulled back beside the hips, weight on the back foot, hood tilted forward.
Right dagger slashes across the body from upper left to lower right, body twisting forward, blade fully visible.
Left dagger follows with a stabbing thrust straight ahead, both arms extended, front knee bent, blade tips farthest from the body.
Follow-through: arms crossed in front, both daggers pointing out, scarf tails whipping.
Recover: daggers brought back to the low guard, feet together, scarf settling.
Gather: both daggers raised crossed above the chest, head bowed, scarf lifting.
Daggers spread wide to either side at shoulder height, blades gleaming, knees bent.
Throw wind-up: right arm back over the shoulder holding one dagger up high, left hand open ahead.
Release: right arm snaps forward, dagger tip pointing far ahead at shoulder height, body leaning into the throw.
Recover: arm extended, then lowering, second dagger returned to the left hand, scarf swirling.
Crouch low, knees bent deeply, head ducked forward, twin daggers held low in both hands pulled in tight.
Launch: body tipping forward, head tucked, back arching, both boots still visible leaving the floor.
Tumble 1: figure curled into a compact ball, head near the knees, back toward the camera side, boots tucked.
Tumble 2: the ball has rotated half a turn, upside down, boots up top, head tucked below.
Tumble 3: rotating up out of the ball, legs reaching down toward the ground, head coming up.
Landing: one knee bent, other boot planted, rising out of the roll, twin daggers held low in both hands back in hand.
Struck: head snaps back, torso leans away from the blow, eyes squeezed shut, arms flung outward, twin daggers held low in both hands.
Recoil: body bent at the waist, knees buckled, one boot sliding back, wincing, twin daggers held low in both hands.
Fatal hit: head snaps back, torso arching, twin daggers held low in both hands loosening in the grip.
Stumble: knees give way, one knee drops, a hand drops the weapon, head hangs.
Fall: body topples sideways, both arms flailing, boots leaving the ground.
Impact: the body lands on its side, weapon clattering beside it, cloth settling.
Slump: the body flat on the ground, one arm stretched out, legs straight, head turned.
Final: lying completely still on the ground, weapon at rest next to the hand, cloth lying flat. Feet on the baseline row.
